name: aeo
description: AEO plugin repository. This manifest exists so AEO's own commit gate can detect AEO's test command and gate AEO's commits (D10 detection, no config file). It declares no version on purpose: the plugin's version lives in plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and nowhere else (D27). This package is private and is never published, so npm does not need one.
